title: Uniform small energy regularity for fractional geometric problems
summary: We prove small energy regularity for a parabolic boundary reaction Ginzburg-Landau problem in the full range $s\in (0,1)$, answering a question posed by Hyder, Segatti, Sire and Wang. We also obtain a similar small energy regularity result for fractional harmonic maps to spheres. Both results are uniform as $s\to 1$.
